name: sameem-hub-production
description: Sameem Hub — production-deployment-ready full-stack monorepo (frontend + backend + Netlify Functions + v1.7 classic dashboard)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.netlify:build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
